Name: Rapid Positioning Capability
Description: The RPC00 tag contains rational function polynomial coefficients and normalization parameters that define the physical relationship between image coordinates and ground coordinates.

SUCCESS.Name: Success Factor
SUCCESS.Description: This field indicates whether RPC values were successfully computed.

ERR_BIAS.Name: Error Bias
ERR_BIAS.Description: This is where the 68% non time-varying error estimate assumes correlated images.

ERR_RAND.Name: Random Error
ERR_RAND.Description: This is the 68% time-varying error estimate that assumes uncorrelated images.

LINE_OFF.Name: Line Offset
LINE_OFF.Description: This is the line offset value in pixels.

SAMP_OFF.Name: Sample Offset
SAMP_OFF.Description: This is the sample offset value in pixels.

LAT_OFF.Name: Geodetic Latitude Offset
LAT_OFF.Description: This is the geodetic latitude offset value in degrees.

LONG_OFF.Name: Geodetic Longitude Offset
LONG_OFF.Description: This is the geodetic longitude offset value in degrees.

HEIGHT_OFF.Name: Geodetic Height Offset
HEIGHT_OFF.Description: This is the geodetic offset value in meters.

LINE_SCALE.Name: Line Scale
LINE_SCALE.Description: This is the line scale value in pixels.

SAMP_SCALE.Name: Sample Scale
SAMP_SCALE.Description: This is the sample scale value in pixels.

LAT_SCALE.Name: Geodetic Latitude Scale
LAT_SCALE.Description: This is the geodetic latitude scale in degrees, and cannot be a value of 0.

LONG_SCALE.Name: Geodetic Longitude Scale
LONG_SCALE.Description: This is the geodetic longitude scale in degrees, and cannot be a value of 0.

HEIGHT_SCALE.Name: Geodetic Height Scale
HEIGHT_SCALE.Description: This is the geodetic height scale in meters, and cannot be a value of 0.

LINE_NUM_COEFF.Name: Line Numerator Coefficients
LINE_NUM_COEFF.Description: This field represents twenty coefficents for the polynomial in the Numerator of the r sub n equation.

LINE_DEN_COEFF.Name: Line Denominator Coefficients
LINE_DEN_COEFF.Description: This field represents twenty coefficents for the polynomial in the Denominator of the r sub n equation.

SAMP_NUM_COEFF.Name: Sample Numerator Coefficents
SAMP_NUM_COEFF.Description: This field represents twenty coefficents for the polynomial in the Numerator of the c sub n equation.

SAMP_DEN_COEFF.Name: Sample Denominator Coefficents
SAMP_DEN_COEFF.Description: This field represents twenty coefficents for the polynomial in the denominator of the c sub n equation.
